notifications.title: Trailer Shorts can be blocked by the Shorts category rule
notifications.detail: Today's trailer Short for L-20261019-01 (credit card minimum payments) could not be made: a credit_card Short (v-20261019-02) already went out today, and the variety rule blocks the same category within 3 Shorts. A trailer has to keep its long video's topic, so it was marked failed (v-20261019-04). Only you can change generator/variety.py.
notifications.fix: 1. Decide whether trailer Shorts (plan.trailer_of) should be exempt from the same-category-in-last-3 rule. 2. If yes, add that exemption in generator/variety.py with a test. 3. If no, nothing to do: Scout will try to prefer long topics whose category is not in the last 3 Shorts.
